verdict.rationale: Helicone documents versioning, comparison and instant rollback for prompts managed through its gateway: commit histories and tags, independent deployment of versions to production, staging and development, and referencing prompts by ID without redeploying. Prompts are the main deployable logic in this product, but its actual automation mechanisms (webhooks, alerts, routing and fallback rules) have no documented versioning, review or rollback. Missing for 10: version history and rollback for webhooks, alerts and routing configurations; a review or approval workflow before changes go live; independent or hands-on corroboration of prompt rollback.
